tasks.title: Task CRUD API
subtasks: Prisma schema for Task per phase-02-architecture.md Data Model
GET /api/tasks (filters: status, assignee, priority)
POST /api/tasks
GET /api/tasks/:id (include syncLinks[])
PATCH /api/tasks/:id
DELETE /api/tasks/:id
acceptance_criteria: All CRUD endpoints match phase-02-architecture.md REST API Surface table
PATCH only enqueues a sync job when a mapped field (priority/status/assignee) changes

tasks.title: Task board/list UI
subtasks: Task list/board view with status columns
Filter by status/assignee/priority
Create/edit task form (fields per data model)
acceptance_criteria: Board reflects live task state from T-1 API
Filtering works without full page reload

tasks.title: Async sync job queue (BullMQ/Redis)
subtasks: Separate queues: sync:jira, sync:github
Retry policy: exponential backoff, fixed attempt cap
SyncAttempt + SyncLink persistence on every job result
acceptance_criteria: Task API requests never block on job execution
A failing job does not block other queued jobs

tasks.title: Jira sync integration
subtasks: Create issue in fixed JIRA_PROJECT_KEY on task create
Update mapped fields (priority/status/assignee) on task update
Close issue (not delete) on task delete
acceptance_criteria: Uses field_mapping.jira below, no translation layer
Delete flow closes rather than deletes the Jira issue

tasks.title: GitHub sync integration
subtasks: Create issue in fixed GITHUB_REPO on task create
Update mapped fields on task update
Close issue (not delete) on task delete
acceptance_criteria: Uses field_mapping.github below, no translation layer
Delete flow closes rather than deletes the GitHub issue

tasks.title: Sync status UI (synced/pending/failed)
subtasks: Per-task sync badge (synced/pending/failed) from syncLinks[]
Failed state shows last_error and links to the external issue if present
acceptance_criteria: A failed sync is visibly distinct from a pending/synced one

tasks.title: OAuth2/SSO auth
subtasks: Wire OAuth2/SSO middleware
Session/token handling for the API
tasks.blocked_reason: SSO provider not yet identified (see phase-02-architecture.md Config section)

tasks.title: Sync-health dashboard
subtasks: GET /api/sync-health endpoint (backend, counts + failing list)
Dashboard view consuming that endpoint
acceptance_criteria: Counts match phase-02-architecture.md Sync-Health Dashboard section
Failing syncs list shows last_error per task

tasks.title: Close linked Jira/GitHub issue on task delete
subtasks: Delete handler enqueues close-issue job per provider with an existing SyncLink
acceptance_criteria: External issue is closed, never deleted
Attempt recorded in SyncAttempt even if the task row is already gone
tasks.blocked_reason: Depends on T-4/T-5, which are blocked on sync target config
